verdict.rationale: A hands-on community report confirms a Snowflake free trial on the Standard plan, where the author ran real workloads (9 credits, 40GB storage, roughly $19.60 of resources) and queried and visualized data in Snowsight. However, no first-party evidence documents the trial itself or its terms, and the story's key conditions (no credit card, no sales call) are not evidenced at all. missing for 10: first-party documentation of the free trial and its credit/duration limits, evidence that signup needs no credit card, evidence that no sales contact is required.
